primitives.name: LatticeScalarAction
primitives.statement: On an even periodic one-dimensional lattice, S(phi)=sum_i[kappa/2*(phi_(i+1)-phi_i)^2 + m2/2*phi_i^2 + lambda/4*phi_i^4].
primitives.operational_definition: A periodic nearest-neighbor Euclidean scalar lattice action.

primitives.name: FiniteSymmetricEnsemble
primitives.statement: The finite witness configuration space is closed under phi -> -phi and weighted by exp(-S(phi)).

definitions.name: BlockVariance
definitions.statement: V_B(phi) is the mean over blocks of (phi_(2j)-phi_(2j+1))^2/4.

claims.statement: For every even lattice configuration, M2(phi)-M2_c(B phi)=V_B(phi).
The scalar action is invariant under phi->-phi and block averaging is equivariant under the same Z2 action.
Every odd observable has zero expectation in the exact finite Z2-symmetric ensemble.
The periodic action density equals kappa*(M2-C1)+(m2/2)*M2+(lambda/4)*M4.
The two-site blocked field alone cannot reconstruct the microscopic action for all configurations.
A useful induced coarse scalar-field description can be selected by minimizing residuals over symmetry-compatible effective operators while carrying an R11 propagation budget.

observables.name: M4
observables.definition: Mean fourth power of the field.

falsifiers.condition: Produce an even lattice configuration for which M2(phi)-M2_c(B phi) differs from V_B(phi).
Produce a periodic configuration for which direct action density differs from the stated moment/correlation decomposition.
Show that the explicit N=4 witness pair has either different blocked fields or equal microscopic actions at kappa=m2=lambda=1.

metadata.purpose: Instantiate Tristan coarse-graining and residual accounting in a concrete finite scalar lattice model.
